title: Highly efficient hydrogenation of furfural to furfuryl alcohol over Cu–Al2O3–ZnO catalyst
content:

Junqi Zhang, Yongwang Li, Zhiwei Zhang, Zheng Wang, Jiaxing Zhang, Shuai Liu, Yang Qin, Bingxin Zhu, Tongxue Zhang, Hongyu Wang, Fumin Wang, Xubin Zhang
The composite metal oxide synthesized by etching achieved over 99% conversion of FAL and selectivity for FOL in mild conditions. Synergy of low-valent Cu and acidic sites ensures high performance, cost-effectiveness, and stability.
